self.battery <= 0:\n                sc = 0\n            print('mission', self.mission, 'score', round(sc, 3), 'dist', round(d, 2), 'bat', round(self.battery, 1), 'got', getattr(self, 'got', 0), '/',  self.new_mission()\n        return res\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    import autopilot\n    seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1\n    s = Sim(seed, int(sys.argv[2]) if {"type":"text","timestamp":1794656283522,"sessionID":"ses_e263776c6ffe24CNrporSLAmfq","part":{"id":"prt_1d9d9ab11001gJkZbvvYSZzPYx","messageID":"msg_1d9d9954c0015BZgyaHyo1ukcn","sessionID":"ses_e263776c6ffe24CNrporSLAmfq","type":"text","text":"The autopilot (`/app/autopilot.py`) played all 6 missions and the campaign finished with the rover ending near base in mission 6. I don't have a campaign score, because the tools don't report one. In my local simulator it averaged about 0.38 per mission over 40 seeds. The simulator is my own approximation of the rules, so the live score could differ.\n\nThe live log shows most targets were sampled, but not all:\n- **Mission 1:** all five initial targets sampled. One of them (t1) was sampled after its deadline, and I did not check whether the later-discovered targets were reached.\n- **Missions 2–5:** the log shows 4–5 confirmed samples per mission. In missions 2, 3 and 4 one sample attempt missed and had to be retried or abandoned; mission 2's retry later succeeded.\n- **Mission 6:** the log ends with two confirmed samples before the mission's final stretch, so it was probably the weakest. The rover finished at (20.2, 19.9), inside base radius, with about 20 battery left.\n\nWhat limits the score:\n- **Energy:** idle drain (25 over 50 ticks) plus sand driving use most of the 100 battery. The planner skips late-appearing targets it can't afford while keeping a 15-unit reserve.\n- **Position noise:** the rover waits several ticks at each target because position fixes arrive late and noisy. A sample is attempted when the estimated chance of being within 0.75 m is at least 0.75, relaxed to 0.6 after four ticks of waiting and 0.4 after eight. Some attempts still missed.\n\nThe detailed log is in `/app/autopilot_detail.log`.","time":{"start":1794656283410,"end":1794656283492}}}
